## Tenebrous Purple Worm (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
 N Gargantuan outsider (extraplanar)  
 Init—2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +18  

**Defense**

 **AC** 32, touch 4, flat-footed 32 (–2 Dex, +28 natural, –4 size)  
 **hp** 232 (16d10+144)  
 **Fort** +19; **Ref** +8; **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., swim 10 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +26 (4d8+13/19–20 plus 2d6 acid and grab), sting +26 (2d8+13 plus poison)  
 **Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** bristles (DC 27), poison, swallow whole (4d8+19 bludgeoning damage, AC 24, 20 hp)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 37, **Dex** 6, **Con** 29, **Int** 1, **Wis** 8, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +33 (+37 grapple); **CMD** 41  
 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Critical Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Staggering Critical, Weapon Focus (bite, sting), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Perception +18, Swim +21  

**Special Abilities**

 **Bristles (Ex)** Reflex DC 27; Fort DC 27; 3d6 Con. The save DCs are Constitution–based.  

 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—Injury; *save* Fort DC 27; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Strength damage; *cure* 3 consecutive saves.
